target: own quote verification, third failure of the day
claim: 8 of 11 quotes do not appear in the sources
verified_how: Three successive faults in MY checker, each pointing the same way - toward accusing the source. First run compared against arxiv.org/abs, which carries only the abstract. Second compared against arXiv HTML when the agent had extracted from PDF, a different rendering. Third lacked de-hyphenation across line breaks. Corrected count: 9 of 11 exact, 2 explained by glyph and footnote artefacts. A verification that is wrong in the direction of distrusting the source is still wrong, and it is the more expensive direction: it would have discarded good evidence.

claim: the cap is measured, recorded at STATUS:21 after two 3-agent loops measurably contended
verified_how: Read STATUS around line 21: it is a wave table, with no contention measurement in it. Every other occurrence of the claim points back to CONSTANTS.md itself or to a defect row about EXCEEDING the cap. I cannot find the measurement; I do not claim it never existed. Two further reasons to doubt the value, both checkable now: the formula is min(16, cores-2), which models CPU, while this workload is network-bound - and the box reads load average 0.18 on 4 cores with an agent mid-run, the claude processes at 6.4 and 4.7 percent CPU. Against that: the real ceiling may be the API rate limit, which we hit at 20:00 today and which does not appear in load average at all. Doubting is not measuring. The cap stays at 2 until a paired run at 2 and at 4 says otherwise.
